title: Planner visual, interaction and Chrome PDF review

authorization.scope: Complete the pending visual and native PDF review of the published planner; repair observed usability issues for review.

browser_access: Chrome skill connection and page operations succeeded this session; prior blocked attempts remain historical evidence.

findings.issue: Day outline textarea collapsed to 77 pixels despite intended 190-pixel rule because shared field styles won the cascade.
findings.fix: Scope the override to the journey notebook with enough specificity and a 300-pixel minimum.
findings.recheck: Chrome computed height 300 pixels; outline and existing text preserved.

findings.issue: Notebook reminder link opened the disclosure but hash navigation took keyboard focus away from the reminder field.
findings.fix: Prevent default hash navigation before opening and focusing the reminder input.
findings.recheck: Chrome activeElement is new-reminder after click.

findings.issue: A4 fixture left one final question alone on a nearly empty page.
findings.fix: Group each place’s short question list and keep its introduction with the first group in native print.
findings.recheck: A4 and Letter contain the question heading and all six Chilika questions on the same page.

browser_checks.sample_retained: Clearly named Utkal QA — day planning sample remains separate in live/local browser storage; original live My Odisha Journey is selected. Backup retained in Downloads.

visual_pdf_review: All 17 final pages rendered and inspected for clipping, overlap, blanks, heading placement and question continuity. No such defects observed in this fixture. Odia text rendered.
limitations: Chrome desktop responsive viewports are not physical phone/tablet testing or a screen-reader pass.
PDFs use Chrome Page.printToPDF through the supported browser capability; native OS print-dialog controls and a physical printer were not exercised.
Bounded fixture: one Chilika place, two days, Odia text, appended outline and one personal reminder. Large plans and illustrated-book PDFs were not visually rechecked.
Local review PDFs contain localhost reading links because they were exported from the local candidate. They are QA evidence, not visitor travel books.
next_action: Founder reviews the three usability fixes before merge and deployment. Physical devices, assistive technology and large/illustrated PDF samples remain separate follow-ups.
